stem: A nutrition program supplies abundant nitrogen but plant performance remains poor. What is the best general conclusion?
choices: Adequate nitrogen does not rule out limitations or imbalances involving other essential nutrients
Nitrogen sufficiency proves all macronutrients are adequate
Poor performance cannot be related to mineral nutrition
The only valid response is to increase nitrogen further
rationale: Essential nutrients have distinct functions, so adequate nitrogen does not establish that phosphorus, potassium, calcium, magnesium, sulfur, or other factors are adequate and balanced.
